brief: Curvature Securities' repo market commentary (Scott Skyrm) is a same-day FOMC preview attached to a routine repo/Treasury funding-rate data sheet (GC, Fed Funds/EFFR, SOFR, Agency MBS levels and charts as of September 15, 10:00 AM, with no additional argument in that section). At the prior FOMC meeting, only a 30% chance of a hike was priced, with no governor guidance, weak employment and above-normal inflation, and the Fed held rates. Over the following six weeks: Chair Warsh signaled openness to higher rates, employment data strengthened, inflation rose, and the long end of the Treasury curve sold off. The market now prices a 92% chance of a hike at tomorrow's meeting, and Skyrm expects a tightening. He flags two possible surprises: a permanent end to Reserve Management Purchases with a plan to shrink the balance sheet, and a very-small-probability 50 basis point move.
